Paragraph: "Thus this way ordered by Sugreeva, the king of monkeys, Hanuma, the son of Air-god made up his mind to go there, where Rama and Lakshmana are..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Executing a delicate mission on behalf of an anxious leader.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuma accepts his duty promptly, resolving to approach the unknown archers.
Outcome/Resolution: He moves into action with purpose and focus.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Karya-Siddhi-Sankalpa (Firm resolve to carry out assigned divine duty)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The ideal devotee (Hanuma) accepts duty readily to bridge the gap between struggling souls and the Supreme.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Duty-driven agency: setting personal hesitation aside to carry out constructive social/organizational responsibilities.
